name: Giving Money
overview: Scripture teaches that giving money is an act of faith and obedience to God, demonstrated through generosity to the poor and faithful support of the church. Proverbs 19:17 emphasizes that showing mercy to the needy is as lending to the Lord Himself, who promises to repay such deeds. Malachi 3:10 calls believers to bring tithes into the storehouse, assuring blessings in return, while Jesus warns in Matthew 6:1 against giving for public recognition, highlighting the importance of sincere motives. The New Testament further encourages cheerful and abundant giving, as seen in Luke 6:38 and Acts 20:35, where giving is described as more blessed than receiving.
